headline: iSponsorBlockTV skips YouTube ads and segments on all YouTube TV clients, using the SponsorBlock API
summary: This self-hosted application connects to your YouTube TV app to automatically skip sponsor segments, intros, and mute ads using the SponsorBlock API. Recent YouTube changes require devices to be re-paired.
details: iSponsorBlockTV is a new self-hosted application designed to enhance the YouTube TV viewing experience. It connects directly to your YouTube TV app to automatically skip unwanted segments like sponsors, intros, and outros in videos.

Beyond segment skipping, the client can also auto-mute YouTube ads and automatically press the "Skip Ad" button the moment it becomes available. This functionality leverages the widely used SponsorBlock API to identify and bypass these sections.

Users should be aware that YouTube has recently changed its screen ID code format, which may require devices to be re-paired with iSponsorBlockTV. Instructions for this process are available in the project's wiki.

There are some known limitations, including ad muting not working when using AirPlay for audio output. Additionally, YouTube Shorts are not fully supported due to platform-side restrictions, though single Shorts can be accessed via specific workarounds.

To run iSponsorBlockTV, you need a computer with network access; it does not necessarily need to be on the same local network as your YouTube TV device, only able to access youtube.com. Auto-discovery during setup, however, does require both devices to be on the same network.
Alternatively, devices can be manually added to iSponsorBlockTV using a YouTube TV code found in your application's settings page.

headline_marked: [[ZapFast: A native WhatsApp client]] in Rust opens in under a second, uses 200MB RAM
headline: ZapFast: A native WhatsApp client in Rust opens in under a second, uses 200MB RAM
summary: This lightweight desktop app for Linux, macOS, and Windows offers significantly faster performance and lower memory usage than WhatsApp Web, opening in under a second and using just 200MB of idle RAM.
details: ZapFast is a new, lightweight WhatsApp client built with Rust and egui, designed for native performance on Linux, macOS, and Windows. In tests, it opens in under a second and consumes only about 200 MB of idle RAM, a significant improvement over WhatsApp Web's 1.13 GB.

It functions as a companion device, linking to your phone via whatsapp-rust without relying on a browser engine. This architecture allows it to store messages locally, so you can read previously received chats even if your phone goes offline.

The application supports native notifications across all three platforms and offers its interface in multiple languages, including English, Chinese, French, German, and Spanish. It maintains WhatsApp's account/chat routing, privacy settings, and notification features.

ZapFast is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Users should be aware that using third-party clients may violate WhatsApp's terms of service and could potentially lead to account suspension. It is recommended to use it at your own risk.
caption:
A new native WhatsApp client, ZapFast, launches for desktop, opening in under a second and using just 200MB RAM. That's 5x less memory than WhatsApp Web!

ZapFast is a new, lightweight WhatsApp client built with Rust and egui, designed for native performance on Linux, macOS, and Windows. In tests, it opens in under a second and consumes only about 200 MB of idle RAM, a significant improvement over WhatsApp Web's 1.13 GB.

It functions as a companion device, linking to your phone via whatsapp-rust without relying on a browser engine. This architecture allows it to store messages locally, so you can read previously received chats even if your phone goes offline.

The application supports native notifications across all three platforms and offers its interface in multiple languages, including English, Chinese, French, German, and Spanish. It maintains WhatsApp's account/chat routing, privacy settings, and notification features.

ZapFast is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Users should be aware that using third-party clients may violate WhatsApp's terms of service and could potentially lead to account suspension. It is recommended to use it at your own risk.
